nodes.label: resonant X-rays

nodes.label: carbon edge

nodes.label: imaginary component of susceptibility (beta)

nodes.label: non-negative matrix decomposition

nodes.label: hyperspectral imaging

nodes.label: polymer-fullerene blend

nodes.label: organic electronic materials

nodes.label: binary contrast

nodes.label: liquid crystal

nodes.label: in-plane structure

nodes.label: transmission experiment

nodes.label: induced polarization

nodes.label: nanoscopic electronic structure

nodes.description: A technique used in scattering experiments to isolate the contributions of different chemical components by modifying the scattering contrast.

nodes.label: interference effects

nodes.label: spatial correlation

nodes.label: Isotropic materials

nodes.label: soft matter

nodes.label: polymeric systems

nodes.label: hard-condensed matter

nodes.label: X-ray fluorescence (XRF)
nodes.description: The emission of secondary X-rays from a sample after excitation, often appearing as background in RSoXS.

nodes.label: unoccupied electron orbital structure
nodes.description: The configuration of unoccupied electronic orbitals in a molecule or material.

nodes.label: hyperspectral scattering
nodes.description: A three-dimensional dataset in RSoXS consisting of 2D scattering patterns acquired at several photon energies across an elemental absorption edge.

nodes.label: anisotropic ratio (A)
nodes.description: A quantitative measure of scattering anisotropy calculated as (Ip - Is) / (Ip + Is), where Ip and Is are intensities parallel and perpendicular to photon polarization.

nodes.label: RSoXS processing
nodes.description: The set of steps to prepare RSoXS data, including masking of noise (dark signals, parasitic scattering) and geometric corrections for solid angle and q-position.

nodes.label: RSoXS data reduction
nodes.description: The process of reducing 3D hyperspectral RSoXS data into 1D intensity profiles (e.g., via azimuthal integration) for visualization and analysis.

nodes.label: Soft matter systems
nodes.description: Materials such as polymers, liquids, and biological systems characterized by weak intermolecular forces and structural flexibility.

nodes.label: model-free analysis
nodes.description: An analysis of scattering data that does not rely on prior knowledge of the system's specific structure, often involving the determination of structure and form factors.

nodes.label: model-based analysis
nodes.description: An analysis approach where a predefined structural or physical model is used to fit and interpret experimental scattering data.

nodes.label: autocorrelation function g(r)
nodes.description: A real-space function derived from the inverse Fourier transform of a scattering profile, providing information on the size of scatterers.

nodes.label: agnostic contrast variation decomposition
nodes.description: A method for decomposing hyperspectral scattering data into constituent material contributions without prior knowledge of the material symmetries or distributions.

nodes.label: coherence length ξc
nodes.description: A measure of the spatial extent over which structural periodicity is maintained.

nodes.label: polarization induced scattering anisotropy (PISA)
nodes.description: Scattering anisotropy induced by polarization, arising from preferential molecular alignment.

nodes.label: bulk heterojunction organic photovoltaic (OPV) devices
nodes.description: Organic solar cells using a bulk heterojunction architecture for charge separation.

nodes.label: small molecule blends
nodes.description: Blends of organic semiconductor materials consisting only of small molecules.

nodes.label: electron donor-acceptor interface
nodes.description: The boundary between electron donor and acceptor materials where charge separation occurs.

nodes.label: organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs)
nodes.description: Organic Electrochemical Transistors, devices used in bioelectronics and sensing that depend on ion transport and nanomorphology.

nodes.label: nonresonant SAXS
nodes.description: Small angle X-ray scattering conducted without resonance to a specific absorption edge.

nodes.label: phase-separated blends
nodes.description: Materials consisting of two or more immiscible phases that have separated into distinct domains.

nodes.label: Porod Invariant formalism
nodes.description: A formal method in scattering analysis used to relate integrated scattering intensity to the volume fractions and contrast of phases.

nodes.label: RMS composition fluctuation
nodes.description: The root mean squared fluctuation of the chemical composition throughout a sample, related to domain purity.

nodes.label: Fourier transform
nodes.description: A mathematical transform used to convert a signal from the spatial or time domain to the frequency domain, fundamental to scattering analysis.

nodes.label: inverse Fourier transform
nodes.description: A mathematical transform used to convert data from the frequency domain (e.g., scattering pattern) back to the spatial domain.

nodes.label: material domain structure
nodes.description: The spatial organization and arrangement of different material phases into domains within a sample.

nodes.label: aromatic resonance
nodes.description: A specific resonance feature in the X-ray absorption spectrum associated with aromatic rings.

nodes.label: spherical core-shell morphology
nodes.description: A morphology where a central core of one material is surrounded by a shell of another material in a spherical geometry.

nodes.label: contrast function
nodes.description: A function representing the difference in scattering contrast between two different material phases.

nodes.label: isotropic
nodes.description: A material property where physical characteristics are independent of the direction of measurement.

nodes.label: polymer tie chains
nodes.description: Polymer chains that connect different crystalline or ordered domains, facilitating charge transport.

nodes.label: OECT
nodes.description: Organic Electrochemical Transistor, a device involving mixed ion-electron transport.

nodes.label: decyl
nodes.description: A ten-carbon linear alkyl chain used as a hydrophobic side group in polypeptoids.

nodes.label: ODT temperature
nodes.description: The temperature at which a block copolymer transitions from an ordered (e.g., lamellar) to a disordered phase.

nodes.label: polypeptoid BCP
nodes.description: A block copolymer consisting of polypeptoid backbones.

nodes.label: contrast variation decomposition
nodes.description: A method used in scattering analysis to separate the contributions of different phases to the total scattering signal to determine composition.

nodes.label: Porod analysis
nodes.description: A scattering analysis method used to characterize the interface between phases in a material.

nodes.label: Guinier plots
nodes.description: A plot used in scattering analysis to determine the radius of gyration of particles.

nodes.label: Teubner Strey
nodes.description: A model used in scattering to describe the structure of disordered systems, such as polymer blends.

nodes.label: resonant X-ray reflectivity (RXR)
nodes.description: A resonant scattering technique that probes the depth profile of the scattering length density and chemical composition normal to the film plane.

nodes.label: Lorentz correction
nodes.description: A data scaling method used in scattering to account for 3D morphology or background, potentially shifting form factor scattering.

nodes.label: SLD
nodes.description: Scattering Length Density, a property describing the scattering power per unit volume of a material.

nodes.label: orientational correlation length (OCL)
nodes.description: A measure of the distance over which the orientation of molecules remains correlated in a material.

nodes.label: bottlebrush BCP
nodes.description: A block copolymer where the polymer chains are grafted to a backbone, creating a bottlebrush-like architecture.

nodes.label: ABC triblock copolymer
nodes.description: A block copolymer consisting of three different polymer blocks (A, B, and C).

nodes.label: Random phase approximation (RPA)
nodes.description: A theoretical framework used to describe the structure and stability of block copolymer phases.

nodes.label: electron tomography
nodes.description: A technique used to produce three-dimensional images of a sample by combining multiple two-dimensional projections.

nodes.label: charge separation efficiency

nodes.label: mixed phase volume fraction

nodes.label: sulfur absorption edge

nodes.label: sulfur edge RSoXS

nodes.label: polystyrene-b-poly(methyl methacrylate) (PS-b-PMMA)

nodes.label: interfacial width
nodes.description: The measured width of the boundary between two phases, which can be composed of the intrinsic width and contributions from interfacial fluctuations.

nodes.label: Order-disorder transition (ODT)

nodes.label: degree of polymerization

nodes.label: long period or pitch (L0)

nodes.label: TSI

nodes.label: Scattering Length Density (SLD)
nodes.description: The contrast in X-ray or neutron scattering determined by the difference in scattering length density between materials.

nodes.label: top-coats

nodes.label: Block Copolymer (BCP)

nodes.label: PS-b-PMMA

nodes.label: scanning TEM tomography

nodes.label: RO membranes

nodes.label: polyamide-based active layers

nodes.label: layer-by-layer process

nodes.label: permselectivity

nodes.label: Debye-Anderson-Brumberger (DAB) model

nodes.label: Correlation lengths LC

nodes.label: water conductivity

nodes.label: fuel cells

nodes.label: meso-scale domain structure

nodes.label: battery separators

nodes.label: drawing

nodes.label: spinning

nodes.label: extruding
nodes.description: A process of pushing material through a die to create a specific shape.

nodes.label: weaving/braiding techniques

nodes.label: diameter

nodes.label: Process-Structure Correlations

nodes.label: CNT forest

nodes.label: yarn

nodes.label: CNT bundle

nodes.label: vapor-phase polymer deposition

nodes.label: porous structure

nodes.label: cross-linked composite yarn

nodes.label: cross-sectional distribution of mass density

nodes.label: temperature-driven crosslinking process

nodes.label: volume contraction

nodes.label: void fraction
